title: Acrylic on canvas | Large format
description:
Daughter of Chabahar
Inspired by a photograph I took during my visit to Chabahar, in southern Iran. I was captivated by its rich colours, traditional clothing, and peaceful everyday beauty, and i wanted to bring that feeling into my painting.

title: Work 03
description:
Acrylic on Canvas | Large format No.2
Children of Chabahar
Inspired by my own photography, capturing a quiet moment of childhood, where the sea meets the horizon and dreams beyond what the eye can see.
